department: Department of Information and Computer Sciences

deadline.value: Fall applicants should apply by January 15; the department gives full consideration to applications received by then.

gre_subject.value: The department FAQ mentions only the GRE General Test.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is suggested but not required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General Test is suggested but not required

toefl_min.value: The department's PhD minimum is 600 paper, 250 computer or 100 internet-based (the older scale).
toefl_min.quote: 600/250/100 or above for the Ph.D. program

supervisor.value: The FAQ does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Full-time students often have a teaching or research assistantship, and offers come with the admission letter.
funding.quote: Full-time graduate students often have some support as either a teaching assistant (TA) or research assistant (RA)

entry_route.value: The FAQ does not say whether a master's is required before the PhD.

notes: PhD applicants need three recommendation letters, per the FAQ.
